offer.text: This is my village to protect, and the monsters grow bold. Help me thin them out — five of the undead should send a message.

accept.text: Good. Watch the alleys and the dark corners.

in_progress.text: How goes the cull? Five of them, remember.

ready.text: Five down. The streets are quieter already.

complete.text: The village owes you a debt. I'll not forget it.
